_notice: NR sidelink (PC5) link profiles for the PUE (relay UE) -> CUE (remote UE) hop. Equations and the values tagged [37.885]/[36.942] are taken from 3GPP TR 37.885 V15.3.0 and TR 36.942 V19.0.0. Values tagged ASSUMPTION are modelling choices pending review. This file is separate from config/marketplace/link_profiles.json, which is frozen with Phase 2 and must not change.

_sources.scenario: ASSUMPTION: 'urban' (SUMO network is an OSM city map). [37.885] Table 6.2-1/6.2.1-1 urban equations.
_sources.bandwidth_mhz: [37.885] Table 6.1.1-1: 10 and 20 MHz baseline for SL. ASSUMPTION: 20 MHz chosen (same as abstract_sidelink_v0)
_sources.ue_noise_figure_db: [37.885] Table 6.1.1-1: UE receiver noise figure 9 dB
_sources.antenna_gain_dbi: [37.885] Table 6.1.4-8 (Option 1, 6 GHz): max directional element gain 3 dBi. ASSUMPTION: max gain used, radiation pattern not modelled (optimistic)
_sources.antenna_heights_m: [37.885] §6.1.2: vehicle Type 2 antenna height 1.6 m, vehicle height 1.6 m. ASSUMPTION: all vehicles Type 2 -> d3D = d2D and NLOSv blockage Case 3
_sources.min_distance_m: IMPLEMENTATION GUARD (not from the TR): distances clipped at 1 m to keep log10 finite
_sources.throughput_mapping: [36.942] Annex A.1 Table A.1, E-UTRA DL baseline (alpha 0.6, SNRmin -10 dB, 4.4 bps/Hz). ASSUMPTION: applied to NR sidelink; TR 37.885 defines no SNR-to-throughput mapping

nr_sidelink_tr37885_v1_highway._sources: Same as nr_sidelink_tr37885_v1 except scenario = highway ([37.885] highway LOS probability and pathloss; no NLOS building state).
